lang_body:
Welcome to *{bot}* 🤖⚡

Choose your preferred language. Every reply will be delivered in it.

_Commands always stay in English (e.g. {p}menu, {p}play)._
owner_only: 🚫 This command is for the owner only.
group_only: 👥 This command works in groups only.
bot_admin: 🤖 I need admin rights to do that.
reply_media: 📎 Send or reply to a supported media/message.
settings_body: Tap any feature to switch it ON or OFF.
group_hint: 👥 Group features can only be changed inside a group.
connect_notice:
🛡️ *Privacy notice*
By linking, {bot} will run on your WhatsApp account. Automation features run only on your account and are OFF by default. You can unlink anytime with {p}logout or from WhatsApp → Linked Devices.
connect_code:
🔐 Pairing code: *{code}*

WhatsApp → Settings → Linked Devices → Link with phone number → enter the code.
connect_limit: 🚧 The bot is full right now.
connect_exists: ℹ️ This number is already linked.
connect_bad: ⚠️ Provide a valid number with country code, e.g. {p}connect 947XXXXXXXX
logout_ok: 👋 Session closed. Your account has been unlinked.
revoked_notice: 🔌 Your session was revoked by the bot owner. This device has been unlinked.
warn_kick: 🚫 {user} reached the limit and was removed.
film_hint: Tap a film to receive it as ONE file. Quality adjusts automatically so it fits WhatsApp.
film_none: 🔍 No full-length film found. Try the exact title (add the year or language).
film_bad_link:
⚠️ Send a YouTube link or an Internet Archive id.
Example: {p}filmdl https://youtu.be/xxxxxxxxxxx 480
film_st_upload:
📤 *Uploading to WhatsApp* ({size})
This can take a few minutes — you'll receive the film as ONE file.
film_busy: ⏳ You already have a film in progress. Wait for it or use {p}filmcancel.
film_dup: ℹ️ This film is already in your queue.
film_q_full: 🚧 The film queue is full ({n}). Try again in a few minutes.
film_too_long: ⏱️ This video is {mins} min — above the {max} min limit.
film_too_big: 📦 Even the lowest quality is larger than the {mb} MB WhatsApp-safe limit.
film_no_space: 💽 The server doesn't have enough free disk space for this film right now. Try again later.
film_no_format: ⚠️ No downloadable video stream was found (live streams and some premium uploads aren't supported).
film_blocked: 🚫 YouTube is blocking the server right now. The owner can fix this by setting YT_COOKIES (see README). Try another upload or the Archive section.
film_unavailable: 🚫 This video is unavailable (private, removed, age-restricted or region-locked).
film_upload_failed: 📤 The film was downloaded but the WhatsApp upload failed. Please try again.
film_uploading: 📤 It's already uploading and can't be cancelled now.
film_failed:
❌ Download failed: {err}
Try again or pick another upload.
film_cancel_none: ℹ️ You have no active film download.
